Dear Mr. Yevhenii,

We would like to inform you that we have received the AED 1,500 security deposit to secure your booking.

On the day of your arrival, the following payment will be due:

First month’s rent: AED 5,100
50% of the last month’s rent: AED 3,550
Total due upon arrival: AED 8,650

Thank you, and we look forward to welcoming you.
